title: Provision of Free Shuttle Bus Service for Residents in Marine Parade, MacPherson and Mountbatten
what_it_is: Provision of Free Shuttle Bus Service for Residents in Marine Parade, MacPherson and Mountbatten

sections.label: Shuttle bus funding questions
sections.summary: Questions ask where funding for the free shuttle bus service comes from, its yearly cost, why it is limited to those constituencies, and whether other constituencies can get funding.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (a) where does the funding for the free shuttle bus service in Marine Parade GRC, MacPherson SMC and Mountbatten SMC come from; (b) what is the cost for funding such service for a year; (c) what is the justification for limiting the service to only residents of those constituencies; and (d) whether such funding can be also made available to other constituencies, and, if so, how.

sections.label: Cluster shuttle bus cost questions
sections.summary: Questions ask the total cost of the cluster-wide community shuttle bus service and how much of the one-year pilot expenditure comes from public funds, donations or other sources.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (a) what is the total cost of the cluster-wide community shuttle bus service covering Marine Parade GRC, MacPherson SMC and Mountbatten SMC as announced by the South East Community Development Council and the People's Association on 30 June 2024; and (b) how much of the expenditure for this one-year pilot is attributed to (i) public funds (ii) donations or (iii) other sources, respectively.

sections.label: Marine Parade Town Cluster shuttle proposal
sections.summary: Grassroots Advisers of Marine Parade GRC, MacPherson SMC and Mountbatten SMC proposed a shuttle bus service to complement public transport and connect residents to key nodes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The Grassroots Advisers of Marine Parade Group Representation Constituency (GRC), MacPherson Single Member Constituency (SMC) and Mountbatten SMC, collectively the Marine Parade Town Cluster, proposed a shuttle bus service that could complement the existing public transport service, to better connect residents to key nodes within the Marine Parade Town Cluster.

sections.label: Shuttle bus annual operating cost
sections.summary: The shuttle bus pilot costs approximately $1 million to operate annually.

sentences.text: The shuttle bus pilot costs approximately $1 million to operate annually.

sections.label: Shuttle registration and funding sustainability
sections.summary: Over 10,000 registered, over 40% seniors, about 1,000 weekly riders; the one-off CDC grant means Grassroots Organisations must raise funds or refine financing for sustainability.

sentences.text: To date, over 10,000 have registered for the shuttle, of which over 40% are seniors aged 65 years and above, and around 1,000 residents have taken the shuttle service every week over the past three weeks.
The CDC grant was provided on a one-off basis.
So, Marine Parade Town Cluster Grassroots Organisations will have to eventually raise funds to cover the entire cost of operations or to refine its financing model for greater sustainability.

sections.label: Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme
sections.summary: Mr Pritam Singh said LTA announced the $900 million Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Mr Pritam Singh: LTA announced the $900 million Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme.

sections.label: CDC one-year pilot review
sections.summary: The CDC will review this pilot after one year and consider whether it suits other divisions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: For this particular pilot, as I mentioned in my reply, the CDC will review this after one year and determine whether this works, and then, we will consider whether it is suitable for other divisions.

sections.label: Marine Parade shuttle bus pilot
sections.summary: The Marine Parade shuttle bus is a pilot community initiative, as Minister of State Alvin Tan mentioned.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: First, as Minister of State Alvin Tan mentioned, this shuttle bus at Marine Parade is a pilot community initiative.

sections.label: Additional $900 million for buses
sections.summary: Up to $900 million over eight years is added to support more buses and bus captains for residents' connectivity needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: But our assessment is that doing that alone would not be adequate because we have more demand than what we can rationalise.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Therefore, we are pumping in an additional up to $900 million over eight years to be able to support more buses, hire more bus captains, so that we are able to meet the connectivity needs of our residents in both existing towns, but also in the newer estates.

sections.label: Ground-up donor-funded pilot project
sections.summary: Alvin Tan says the ground-up, donor-funded pilot uses CDC seed funding and will be assessed after one year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Mr Alvin Tan: Sir, I mentioned that this is a ground-up initiative, largely private donor-funded.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: This is one local community project and that is where CDC funding comes in as a seed fund.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: It is a pilot to see whether there is use, potentially.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: They will assess it after one year to see whether it is useful to do it elsewhere.
But I wish to caveat, and I had mentioned in my reply, that it is not very straightforward, that these are subject to utilisation rates, these are also subject to financial sustainability.

sections.label: Service utilisation after three weeks
sections.summary: Determining proper utilisation is important, and the service has run for about three weeks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
sentences.text: This is important in determining whether the service is being properly utilised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: It has only been running for about three weeks.

sentences.text: The short answer is that there are pictures of other Marine Parade landmarks, including Wisma Geylang Serai Market and Old Airport Road Hawker Centre.
